overclaims: Early ARC-AGI-2 tests put it under 30% where smart humans scored over 95%.
The same source still judged o3 far from human-level, so the core claim holds.
Early tests showed a large gap between the best model and humans on fresh novel tasks.
checks.note: ARC-AGI-2 figures were tentative projections, not established scores. The source says o3 was not AGI, while arguably approaching human-level performance in the ARC-AGI domain; it does not say 'far from human-level.' Disclose that o3 was a preview trained on ARC public data. The quoted GSM-Symbolic version dates to August 2025; the packet does not establish that its quoted findings appeared in October 2024 v1.
